An '''enhanced energy cell''' was a modified [[Energy cell (vibroblade)|energy cell]] that was used to augment and stabilize many types of [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]]. It smoothed the flow of power to the weapon that requires a power pack, making it less likely to produce unpredictable results. The Mark II, III, & IV versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in the potential for energy damage.
